_about: Fingerprints of the XSL-FO of three builds (see canon() in jss-cover-isolation.test.js: the checkout location and the attribute order are ignored, so the value is the same in every folder on every machine). Re-captured 2026-11-23 at the merge of the JSS authoring work (Videos copy) with the S1000D Phase 20-22d work. Both pre-merge trees, measured separately before any file was combined, gave exactly these values - so neither the JSS edits nor the S1000D edits moved any of these three builds - and the merged tree must give them again. The earlier values were captured with the checkout location inside them and could not be reproduced in any other folder. Update only when a change to these pipelines is intended and reviewed. capturedOn is the calendar day of the capture: the FO of an S1000D build prints the day it was built ("Issue No. 001, 2026-11-23"), so the test replaces the day of the run with capturedOn before it fingerprints (see norm()), and the values stay valid on every other day. RE-CAPTURED 2026-11-24 (legacy-jss-uhb and s1000d-via-jss only; s1000d-direct is unchanged and still equals the 2026-11-23 value) at the merge of the Naval work with the owner's commit eb43711 (ancillary pages). That commit changes four files every jsstofo build uses, on purpose and in every profile: vendor/pipeline/jsstofo/pagesetup.xsl (the pad pages that close a chapter or a front-matter part carry the running head and foot), tables.xsl and warnings.xsl (a table and a notice span the full text width at every heading level), and templates/uhb.house.json (chapter titles 21 pt instead of 18 pt). Shown to be the whole cause: with exactly those four files put back to their previous content, all three builds gave the 2026-11-23 values again, byte for byte. The S1000D direct engine does not include them and did not move. The "chars" of the two re-captured cases were not re-measured and are left out. RE-CAPTURED 2026-11-25 (legacy-jss-uhb and s1000d-via-jss only; s1000d-direct is unchanged and still equals the 2026-11-23 value) at the merge of the Naval work with the owner's commits c4bc7bf and d727032. c4bc7bf adds default artwork for every JSS book (applyDefaultArtwork in publisher.ts, vendor/pipeline/jss/artwork: the stencil's emblem, Larsen & Toubro logo and first-aid figures, used when the project has no such file in its Media folder), on purpose and for the two JSS paths only; its own test asserts that the direct S1000D engine never gets it. Shown to be the whole cause: with applyDefaultArtwork switched off all three builds gave the previous values again, byte for byte; with it on, the only differences in the XSL-FO are the src of the emblem, publisher-logo and first-aid pictures (12 lines in the old JSS path, 8 in S1000D through JSS) and the first-aid box height (115 mm to 145 mm, fm.firstAidImageHeight) in the old JSS path.
